280102550.description:
Radical Scientific Equipments
Advanced Rock & Mineral Collection
36-Piece Geological Specimen Set
9" x 9" x 2"
Educational Geology Kit
This professional-grade geological collection features 36 distinct rock and mineral specimens curated for educational study and identification. Produced by Radical Scientific Equipments, the set encompasses a broad spectrum of earth materials including igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks alongside diverse mineral samples. From the metallic luster of galena and graphite to the crystalline structures of rose quartz and geodes, this collection serves as an essential reference for students and earth science enthusiasts.
Specimens are housed in a clear protective tray with individual compartments
Includes a comprehensive identification key matching specimens to their numbers
Features a diverse range of materials including sulfur, obsidian, and azurite
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The identification sheet is clean and fully legible. The specimens remain well-preserved within their original sorting tray. The outer cardboard box displays minor edge wear and light scuffing consistent with careful storage and handling.
